newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia to bid for UN Security Council seat.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia to bid for UN Security Council seat.

text.p: Slovenian Prime Minister Janez Drnovsek announced on Friday the country's candidacy for membership in the U.N. Security Council in 1998 and 1999.
"Membership in the council would offer Slovenia an opportunity to gain even better international recognition," Drnovsek told a new conference.
"We believe we have a realistic chance to join the council, considering our international ties and diplomatic capabilities," he added.
The U.N. will make a decision about the new Security Council members in September 1997.
Slovenia's decision to announce its candidacy came two months ahead of general elections set for November 10.
